body.name: Three-state forest integration messages
body.construction: Root each tree and put \(f_v(x)=h_{\ell v}x^{h_{\ell v}-1}\). For each child \(u\) define \(J_u(z)=\int_0^1B_u(y,z)\,dy\), \(D_u(z)=\int_0^1(A_u(y,z)+B_u(y,z))\,dy\), and \(E_u(x,z)=J_u(z)+\int_0^xA_u(y,z)\,dy\). Then \(A_v(x,z)=zf_v(x)\prod_u(J_u(z)+\int_0^xC_u(y,z)\,dy)\), \(C_v(x,z)=f_v(x)\prod_uE_u(x,z)\), and \(B_v(x,z)=f_v(x)(\prod_uD_u(z)-\prod_uE_u(x,z))\), with unselected states suppressed at tagged vertices and root output \(\int_0^1(A_v+B_v)\,dx\).
